images.name: seethisplaceinjanuary

texts.text: Cold? It's June. You should see this place in January.

images.joke: Cold? It's June. You should see this place in January.
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God stands in the snow with a coffee: "Cold? It's June. You should see this place in January."
images.note: The photo of the frozen fjord is redrawn as the rig's snow scene; the words are reset in the brand serif.

images.name: sweat

images.note: The sweat drops on his face and legs are gone (the rig can't draw them); the puddle stays.
